designNotes.trackGain: gain range: −∞ at minimum; finite range −70 db to +6 db. mock fills use a linear finite-db scale; exact taper is undecided.
designNotes.buttons: momentary actions use circles or rounded pills; persistent toggles and mutually exclusive view selectors use rectangular controls. fields and sliders are not buttons.
designNotes.clips: audio and midi clips share 14 px headers and dark names. midi notes are dark bars on the clip color.
designNotes.themes: neutral black, grey and white interface with blue highlights at different values and saturations; tracks, collections and sections use eight colorful non-blue element colors, with darker normal and brighter accented clip shades.
designNotes.tuner: the toolbar opens an illustrative no-signal tuner panel; pitch detection is not implemented in the frame prototype.
designNotes.recording: the first arrangement track illustrates active recording: red arm control and a translucent red track overlay; track meters show left and right channels.
designNotes.browserToggle: bottom-left browser toggle shows and hides the browser in this fixed-layout prototype; surrounding panels do not reflow.
designNotes.timeSelection: time-selection state illustrates a light blue selected range across two arrangement tracks.
designNotes.trackTags: tagged tracks show a color-coded dot inside a dark circle at the upper right of their headers.
designNotes.sectionPlay: section play controls are illustrative in the Frame prototype.
designNotes.trackDisclosure: track disclosure controls are illustrative in the Frame prototype.
designNotes.deviceToggle: adjust illustrates on and off states in Frame; no audio processing is controlled by the prototype.
designNotes.groupSections: group clips cover the span of their member clips and show miniature member content; empty spans have no group clip.
designNotes.compactFrame: the toolbar shares the titlebar row; the project name is in the status line and the loop indicator sits within the ruler.
designNotes.sessionConcept: the session view is an illustrative clip grid and mixer with example tracks, return tracks and main output; controls and levels are examples.
designNotes.sessionDock: arrangement and session views use compact device docks.
designNotes.deviceHeaders: each device has a left rail with its name, power indicator, and modulator toggle. an open tray sits between the rail and the controls. nested slots use right-pointing triangles.
designNotes.deviceHeight: All device hosts use a shared 200-pixel height, including Vector, Delay and Adjust. Vector keeps its compact chain width and uses the Hex host modulation system.
designNotes.oscillators: Four compact oscillators with ratio, frequency offset, level/modulation depth and independent keytrack sliders. Keytrack examples are 100%, 100%, 50% and 0%.
designNotes.keytrack: Vertical keytrack sliders have no numeric readout. Colored fill grows upward inside their thicker 12-pixel inset channels.
designNotes.oscillatorSwitches: Oscillator on/off buttons are one third of their previous width, have no visible label and use their full oscillator color when enabled.
designNotes.oscillatorControls: Ratio and Hz fields are 44 pixels wide; 12-pixel vertical keytrack sliders sit beside the on/off switches. Level knobs and readouts follow the compact field stack.

styleguide.prompt: use neutral black, grey and white interface surfaces with blue highlights in varied values and saturations. use eight more colorful non-blue element colors for tracks, clips, collections and sections; clips have normal and accented shades. one-shot actions are circles or pills; toggles are rectangular.
rules: all app text is lowercase
all app text uses Ioskeley Mono
flat surfaces, one-pixel dividers, no decorative cards
keep transport and track context visible
prototype states do not establish audio or device behavior
preserve Live density; minimal dead space, small gutters, compact controls and contiguous panels
structural dividers are darker than the panels; text is softened but readable
browser tags are individually outlined chips at existing compact row positions
concept beauty takes priority over unique clip hue identification; text remains readable
clip colors are user-defined; maximum 64 saved swatches
one-shot buttons use full circles or rounded pills
toggled controls and mutually exclusive view selectors use rectangular shapes
fields, sliders, panels and user-colored clips are not classified as buttons
audio and midi clip headers share a 14 px height and dark names
black and grey surfaces use neutral greys without a noticeable color cast
tracks, collections and sections use eight shared, colorful non-blue element colors
clips inherit their track color, either normal or a related accented shade
midi note previews use dark bars on the full clip-color background
accented clip shades: #ce7967, #d79659, #c5ae5b, #95b56b, #6bb68b, #6bb3aa, #b780ad, #d37c94
group and section clips use a distinct darker tier of their element colors
arrangement and console share a top-right view switch
the browser toggle sits at the bottom left and the clip and device editor switch sits at the bottom right
nested group headers use continuous colored rails and rounded dividers
selected devices use a blue outline; the header uses the device body surface
